page.layout: One printed page of text. Running head at the top, centred, with the page number at top right. Line numbers (5, 10, 15 and so on) stand in the left margin as line counts, not as notes, so they are not transcribed. Signature at lower left, catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: 249. Ozias, dux Bethulienfis, minimè quidem fortis aut perseverans, alios audiens,illisque obsequens, bene meretur de populo Dei.

250. Joachimus, sacerdos, Assyriorum adventu nuntiato, angustiás montium, & aditus viarum claudit, per urbes & castella milites disponit: inprimis Dei iram jamiam grassantem, suadet mitigandam abstinentiâ & emenda-tione, promittitque praesens Dei auxilium poenitentibus. Audita Bethulienfium victoriâ, Deo gratias agit solen-niter.
251. Sufanna, Ioachimi uxor, non minus sanctitate, quâ forma praestans, justo Dei judicio liberatur à testimonio & judicio hominum injusto.

252. Daniel, in universo Chaldaeorum regno, excelluit sapientiâ, fortitudine, & pietate, charus & utilis Nebucadnezari, Evilmerodacho, Belsazeri, Dario & Cyro, à quibus omnibus est & praemiis & honoribus affectus. Sepulchrum eius Babylone in angiportu multis seculis notum fuit.

253. Nebucadnezar, cognomento Magnus, post multas victorias, à Daniele institutus consequitur veri Dei notitiam: ab eodem admonitus, ut fastum nimium deponeret, viro Dei non obsequitur. Eiectus ig. in solitudinem, ibi obbrutescit animo & corpore. Ad sanitatem rediens, in solium rursus collocatur, Deumque animo grato & humili colit.

254. Sadrach, Mefach, & Abednego, socii Danielis, propter stirpem regiam & ingeniorum ac formae excellentiâ, in andronem regium accersuntur. Brevi tempore ita emi-nent sapientiâ, ut praefecturis provinciarum ornentur: juvenes ad res maximas nati & accommodati. Erectum regi colossum cùm adorare nollent, in caminum ardente ligati conjiciuntur: sed servati à Deo, inde liberantur, & majoribus quàm antea dignitatibus euehuntur.
255. Aspenas, aulae Babylonicae praefectus, singulari a-more & benevolentiâ complectitur Danielem & eius so-

page.notes: Line numbers in the left margin (5 to 35) are line counts and not transcribed. Show-through marks at the left edge (such as the 0 and 5 marks) are from the facing page and are left out. Signature printed as "LI 3", read here as "Ll 3". The word in 254 printed as "regium" and the name "Belsazeri" are read with some doubt, and "angustiás" carries a mark over the a that is hard to read. The page ends on the broken word "so-", with the catchword "cios." below.
